card.statement:
([BK08, Definition 1.9, reformulated]).

A restricted quantized algebra $A$ over $k$ is a flat $k[\![\hbar]\!]$ -algebra with a Poisson bracket $\{-,-\}$ and a power operation $(-)^{[p]}:A\to A$ preserving $\hbar$ such that

•

$(A,\{-,-\})$ together with $(-)^{[p]}$ is a restricted Lie algebra:

(1)

for $\forall a\in k$ and $x\in A$ , we have $(ax)^{[p]}=a^{p}x^{[p]}$ ,

(2)

$\{x^{[p]},y\}=(\mathrm{ad}\ x)^{p}(y)$ for $x,y\in A$ , and

(3)

$(x+y)^{[p]}=x^{[p]}+y^{[p]}+L(x,y)$ , where $L(x,y)$ is the Lie polynomial defined by

$\hbar^{p-1}L(x,y)=(x+y)^{p}-x^{p}-y^{p};$

•

we have

(4.1)

$\hbar\{x,y\}=[x,y]=xy-yx,\quad\quad\forall x,y\in A,$

i.e., the quantization condition;

•

$(xy)^{[p]}=x^{p}y^{[p]}+x^{[p]}y^{p}-\hbar^{p-1}x^{[p]}y^{[p]}+P(x,y)$ , where $P(x,y)$ is the universal polynomial defined by

(4.2)

$\hbar^{p-1}P(x,y)=(xy)^{p}-x^{p}y^{p}.$

We introduce an additional flatness assumption to the definition in [BK08] so that the following characterization holds. Note that by [BK08, Equation (1.7)], we have $(\hbar x)^{[p]}=\hbar x^{p}$ given that $s$ defined below is an algebra map using the flatness assumption. By passing to the classical limit $\hbar=0$ , one obtains a notion of a restricted Poisson algebra [BK08, Definition 1.8].
card.label: Definition 4.1

paper.title: 3D mirror symmetry in positive characteristic
paper.abstract: Via the formulation of (quantum) Hikita conjecture with coefficients in a characteristic $p$ field, we explain an arithmetic aspect of the theory of 3D mirror symmetry. Namely, we propose that the action of Steenrod-type operations and Frobenius-constant quantizations intertwine under the (quantum) Hikita isomorphism for 3D mirror pairs, and verify this for the Springer resolutions and hypertoric varieties.
